note.zh: 在隔离测评工作区中，通过 AntiGravity CLI 1.1.13 的精确选择器 gemini-3.7-flash（Medium）使用仓库标准中文提示词一次生成，源码未经人工修改，耗时 1 分 28 秒。原生系统提示正常启用，工作区未注入 AGENTS.md、额外上下文文件、外部 Skill、插件或 MCP，外部 URL 与 Web Search 动作被阻断；由于 AntiGravity 没有可验证的内置 Skill 与上下文发现总开关，隔离状态为 partial。CLI 未回报运行时模型 ID，归因依据为已选择的精确目录项。交付修复仅将原始 HTML 通过 CDN 请求的 Three.js 0.128.0 精确内联，未修改游戏逻辑；原始归档与远端对象已保留，并通过审计 repair-artifact 路径发布。
note.en: Generated one-shot from the repository's canonical Chinese prompt in an isolated benchmark workspace using AntiGravity CLI 1.1.13 with the exact gemini-3.7-flash selector (Medium), with unmodified source, in 1 minute 28 seconds. The native system prompt remained enabled, no AGENTS.md, extra context files, external skills, plugins, or MCP were injected, and outbound URL and Web Search actions were blocked. Because AntiGravity has no verifiable master switch for bundled skills or context discovery, isolation is recorded as partial. The CLI did not report a runtime model ID; attribution is based on the exact selected catalog entry. The delivery-only repair precisely inlines Three.js 0.128.0, which the original HTML requested from a runtime CDN, without changing game logic; the original archive and remote object are preserved, and the repair was published through the audited repair-artifact path.

note.zh: 在修正运行环境配置后，以明确的第 2 次子尝试通过 AntiGravity CLI 1.1.13 的精确选择器 gemini-3.7-flash（Medium）使用仓库标准中文提示词生成，源码未经人工修改，耗时 5 分 40 秒。Agent 实际完成生产构建并交付浏览器可运行的 dist/index.html；真实浏览器验收可进入 5v5 场景，HUD、雷达与冻结时间正常显示。运行隔离为 partial，外部 URL 与 Web Search 动作被阻断。产物额外引入了题目允许列表之外的 lucide-react，按原样保留并在此披露。此前受基础设施配置影响的父尝试不计作模型结果。
note.en: Generated from the repository's canonical Chinese prompt after the runtime configuration was corrected, as an explicit second child attempt using AntiGravity CLI 1.1.13 with the exact gemini-3.7-flash selector (Medium), with unmodified source, in 5 minutes 40 seconds. The Agent completed a production build and delivered a browser-ready dist/index.html; a real-browser acceptance check entered the 5v5 scene with the HUD, radar, and freeze timer visible. Isolation is partial, and outbound URL and Web Search actions were blocked. The artifact additionally imports lucide-react outside the case's allowed dependency list; it is retained unchanged and disclosed here. The earlier parent attempt affected by infrastructure configuration is excluded from the model result.

note.zh: 在修正运行环境配置后，以明确的第 2 次子尝试通过 AntiGravity CLI 1.1.13 的精确选择器 gemini-3.7-flash（Medium）使用仓库标准中文提示词生成，耗时 4 分。Agent 执行了 bun run build 并交付 dist/index.html；原始产物启动时因模型生成的手枪体素层混用 10 列与 11 列数据而抛出 every row needs the same length，页面白屏。应维护者要求，人工将 src/props.ts 中 SIDE_MID 的 6 行各删去 1 个多余字符，使三层统一为 10 列；除此之外未修改模型代码，也未重跑模型。修复后已通过真实浏览器启动与播放验收，原始 Runner 归档仍保留；此前受基础设施配置影响的父尝试不计作模型结果。
note.en: Generated from the repository's canonical Chinese prompt after the runtime configuration was corrected, as an explicit second child attempt using AntiGravity CLI 1.1.13 with the exact gemini-3.7-flash selector (Medium), in 4 minutes. The Agent ran bun run build and delivered dist/index.html; the original artifact failed at startup with "every row needs the same length" and showed a blank page because its model-generated pistol voxel layers mixed 10-column and 11-column rows. At the maintainer's request, a manual repair removed one extra character from each of the six SIDE_MID rows in src/props.ts so all three layers are 10 columns wide; no other model-authored code was changed, and the model was not rerun. The repaired artifact passed real-browser startup and playback acceptance, while the original Runner archive remains preserved. The earlier parent attempt affected by infrastructure configuration is excluded from the model result.
